title: Clopen rank stratum homology presentation
statement: Let i: Z → Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], A=i_*O_Z with module direct image g_* [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], and choose D(A) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let r: Z → ℕ be locally constant with strata U_q [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], E_q arbitrary module sheaves on U_q, and T^m=j_{m,*}E_m for m≥0, T^m=0 for m<0. Let K lie in D(A) and n in ℤ. Assume H^m(K)≅g_*T^m for every m≠n. There exists a retract L of K, with maps ι:L→K and π:K→L satisfying ι≫π=id_L, such that H^m(L)=0 for every m≠n and every map a:g_*T^n→H^n(K) satisfies a≫H^n(π)≫H^n(ι)=a. Thus it is the rank-n retract L, rather than all of K, that has a single-degree homology presentation.

source.place: expanded proof of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, idempotent splitting and truncation

proof.text: For nonnegative n take the derived projector for q=n.toNat. For nonnegative m≠n, m.toNat≠q and the prescribed support isomorphism imply H^m(L)=0. For negative m the prescribed T^m is zero; homology of K is zero and its retract homology is zero. The fixed-map clause follows from T^n=j_{q,*}E_q.
For negative n, T^n=0. Take L=0 and both maps zero. The retract identity follows from id_0=0, homology of zero is zero, and all maps from the zero source agree.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenRankStrata_homology_presentation
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).toScheme.Modules)
    (T : ℤ → Z.Modules)
    (hT : ∀ n : ℤ, T n = if 0 ≤ n then
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n.toNat).ι).obj
        (E n.toNat) else 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (n : ℤ)
    (hother : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj K ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T m))) :
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
      (ι : L ⟶ K) (π : K ⟶ L),
      ι ≫ π = 𝟙 L ∧
      (∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ a : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T n) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj K,
        a ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).map π ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).map ι = a)

statement_change.old_statement: In the clopen rank-stratum situation of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, for K and n there exists an isomorphism e from the n-th homology of K placed in degree n to K whose induced map under the canonical single-complex homology identification is the identity.

old_proof.text: Split K by the characteristic idempotent of the rank-n clopen stratum. The complementary summand has zero homology in every degree by the hypotheses on the other strata, while the image summand has only its n-th homology. Canonical truncation identifies this summand with the n-th homology placed in degree n; composing with the inclusion gives e, and naturality gives the identity equation.

statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the old conclusion was false. Take Z=Y=Spec(k), i=id, r constantly 0, E_0=O_Z, T^0=O_Z and all other T zero, K=O_Z in degree 0 and n=-1. The hypotheses hold but H^-1(K)=0, so its single complex cannot be isomorphic to nonzero K. Replace the false whole-object presentation with a concentrated retract and the fixed-map identity, the actual steps the lifting argument needs. No hypothesis has been added and the lifting theorem is unchanged.

citers.note: The lifting conclusion and every hypothesis stay unchanged. Its proof now factors a through H^n(π), lifts to the concentrated retract via the existing Mathlib t-structure theorem, and composes with ι; the fixed-map identity proves the required homology equation.
